uncited: **Coordinate Discretization**: For each point $(x, y, z)$, compute the floor and ceiling indices along each axis.
Let $D_x, D_y, D_z$ be the grid dimensions.
Permute x and y axes using matrix $\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$.
It is chosen when using JAX-based pipelines with specific coordinate transformations for image plane or voxel interpolation.
- **Limitations**: Does not handle non-axis-aligned grids (use [Curvilinear to Rectilinear Resampling](2248-curvilinear-to-rectilinear-resampling.md)).
